text.offer: Duke Akardius says, "Qor gives nothing for free, and nor do I. Zuxana asks an offering for the darkness she lends my soldiers: bring her one. And Jonas has bought swords. The bandit captains on the roads take his coin. Kill three of them."
text.progress: Zuxana takes an offering to Qor. The bandit captains lead their gangs in the hills.
text.complete: Duke Akardius says, "Then you have paid the price, and I name you one of my Captains in truth. When you have risen to the rank, ask me for my gift: say champion."

steps.objective: Bring Zuxana an offering to Qor
Bandit captains in Jonas's pay slain
steps.brief: Zuxana is satisfied. Now Jonas's hired swords: three bandit captains.
